lines.zh: 十几对脚一起走，像下雨
lines.en: A dozen pairs of legs. It sounds like rain.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但每一步都稳
lines.en: I'm slow, but every step is steady.

lines.zh: 背甲分节，转弯要一节节来
lines.en: Segmented shell. I turn plate by plate.

lines.zh: 湿叶子底下好走，不磨脚
lines.en: Under wet leaves the going is soft.

lines.zh: 滚过石头，壳上沾了泥
lines.en: Rolled over a stone. Mud on my shell.

lines.zh: 前面有根树枝，我绕过去
lines.en: A twig ahead. I go around it.

lines.zh: 箱子在背上，重心得靠前
lines.en: Chest on my back. I lean forward.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我刹不住
lines.en: Don't block the way. I can't brake.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，那里潮
lines.en: I follow the wall base. Damp there.

lines.zh: 脚太多，有时踩到自己
lines.en: Too many legs. Sometimes I step on myself.

lines.zh: 下坡就缩起来滚下去
lines.en: Downhill, I curl up and roll.

lines.zh: 土松的地方，脚会陷进去
lines.en: Loose soil. My feet sink in.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但从不迷路
lines.en: Not fast, but I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 找个阴湿的角落待着
lines.en: Find a damp shady corner and stay.

lines.zh: 触角伸出去，探探风
lines.en: Antennae out, testing the air.

lines.zh: 壳有点干，我往苔藓里挪
lines.en: Shell drying out. I shift into the moss.

lines.zh: 我缩成球了，没事别叫我
lines.en: I'm a ball now. Don't call me unless needed.

lines.zh: 腐叶的味道，闻着踏实
lines.en: Smell of rotting leaves. Comforting.

lines.zh: 箱子压着背，翻身很费劲
lines.en: Chest weighs on me. Rolling over is hard.

lines.zh: 蚂蚁从旁边过，互不打扰
lines.en: Ants pass by. We ignore each other.

lines.zh: 我数自己的脚，总也数不清
lines.en: I count my legs. Never finish.

lines.zh: 石头底下凉，正合适
lines.en: Cool under the stone. Just right.

lines.zh: 壳上的纹路，一年长一圈
lines.en: A ring on my shell for every year.

lines.zh: 我憋着气不动，装成石头
lines.en: I hold still and pass for a pebble.

lines.zh: 苔藓长得比我快
lines.en: The moss grows faster than I do.

lines.zh: 雨停了吗，壳上还滴水
lines.en: Rain stopped? Water still drips off me.

lines.zh: 有人在翻石头，我该挪窝了
lines.en: Someone's flipping stones. Time to move.

lines.zh: 卷起来的时候，世界很安静。
lines.en: Rolled up, the world goes quiet.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我们才一样高
lines.en: Crouch down. Then we're eye to eye.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在触角旁边，很小
lines.en: My eyes sit by my antennae. Tiny.

lines.zh: 你手上那朵蘑菇，我认得
lines.en: That mushroom in your hand. I know it.

lines.zh: 别用手指戳我的壳
lines.en: Don't poke my shell with a finger.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子快扭了
lines.en: I look up at you. My neck aches.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我了，凉快
lines.en: Your shadow covers me. Nice and cool.

lines.zh: 壳上有个缺口，天生的
lines.en: A notch in my shell. Born with it.

lines.zh: 你靴子上沾着泥，像我家的土
lines.en: Mud on your boots. Looks like home soil.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，因为没有眼皮
lines.en: I don't blink. I have no eyelids.

lines.zh: 你离远点，我才能把脚伸开
lines.en: Back up so I can stretch my legs.

lines.zh: 我在看你腰间的那个箱子
lines.en: I'm eyeing that chest at your waist.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我的样子好笑吗
lines.en: What's funny? Is my shape a joke?

lines.zh: 火把太烫，退后一点
lines.en: The torch is too hot. Step back.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步声，很重
lines.en: I know your footsteps. Very heavy.

lines.zh: 你手里没有蘑菇，我不动。
lines.en: No mushroom in your hand. I stay put.

lines.zh: 你蹲太久了，膝盖会酸。
lines.en: You crouched too long. Your knees will ache.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你挡住了光。
lines.en: I look at you because you block my light.

lines.zh: 别把我翻过来，我怕露肚子。
lines.en: Don't roll me over. My belly is not for showing.

lines.zh: 你背的包比我的箱子大。
lines.en: Your pack is bigger than my chest.

lines.zh: 你的手指在壳上敲，很吵。
lines.en: Your finger tapping my shell is loud.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道缝，麻烦
lines.en: A crack in my shell. That's trouble.

lines.zh: 我缩成球了，别踢
lines.en: I'm curled up. Don't kick.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我腿发麻
lines.en: The blow numbed my legs.

lines.zh: 我的壳不是铁做的
lines.en: My shell isn't made of iron.

lines.zh: 疼倒还好，就是壳凹了
lines.en: The pain's fine. The dent isn't.

lines.zh: 别翻我，翻过来我起不来
lines.en: Don't flip me. I can't right myself.

lines.zh: 有液体渗出来了，不妙
lines.en: Something's leaking out. Not good.

lines.zh: 我往叶堆里钻，躲一躲
lines.en: I burrow into the leaves to hide.

lines.zh: 你踩的那一脚，我记住了
lines.en: I remember that stomp of yours.

lines.zh: 让我缓一会儿，脚收不回去
lines.en: Give me a moment. My legs won't fold.

lines.zh: 红伞白杆的，我最喜欢
lines.en: Red cap, white stem. My favorite.

lines.zh: 蘑菇给我，箱子归你背
lines.en: The mushroom for me. You carry the chest.

lines.zh: 我不挑，林地菇也行
lines.en: I'm not picky. Forest mushrooms work too.

lines.zh: 蘑菇举太高，我够不着
lines.en: That mushroom's too high for me to reach.

lines.zh: 这朵有点蔫，凑合吃
lines.en: This one's wilted. Good enough.

lines.zh: 我闻到菌丝的味道了
lines.en: I smell the mycelium already.

lines.zh: 别在我眼前晃来晃去
lines.en: Don't dangle it back and forth at me.

lines.zh: 吃完这朵，我就认你
lines.en: One mushroom and I'm yours.

lines.zh: 我不吃生肉，别拿来试
lines.en: No raw meat. Don't test me with it.

lines.zh: 蘑菇底下有虫子，正好一起
lines.en: Bugs under the cap. Bonus.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一朵，真可惜
lines.en: You crushed one. A real shame.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬过去，别催
lines.en: I'm crawling over. Don't rush me.

lines.zh: 这味道像雨后的腐木
lines.en: Smells like rotten wood after rain.

lines.zh: 吃完了，还有吗
lines.en: Done already. Any more?

lines.zh: 蘑菇切碎了？那我也认。
lines.en: Mushroom cut up? I'll still take it.

lines.zh: 你把蘑菇放地上，我就来。
lines.en: Set it on the ground and I'll come.

lines.zh: 再多一朵，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One more cap and I follow you.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，我滚了半圈
lines.en: You kicked me. I rolled half a turn.

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你该低头看路
lines.en: I'm this low. Look down when you walk.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，壳很硬
lines.en: Bumping is fine. My shell is hard.

lines.zh: 别踩，壳裂了补不上
lines.en: Don't step on me. Cracked shells don't heal.

lines.zh: 我被撞翻了，帮我翻回来
lines.en: I got flipped. Help me turn over.

lines.zh: 箱子磕到你的腿了吧
lines.en: The chest clipped your leg, didn't it?

lines.zh: 慢点走，我躲不开
lines.en: Slow down. I can't dodge.

lines.zh: 你把我推到泥里了
lines.en: You pushed me into the mud.

lines.zh: 靠边点，我沿着墙走
lines.en: Keep to the side. I hug the wall.

lines.zh: 我这身子，撞谁谁发麻
lines.en: This body of mine numbs whoever it hits.

lines.zh: 两只一起缩成球，就算成了
lines.en: Two balls curled together. That's a yes.

lines.zh: 先找个湿树皮底下
lines.en: Somewhere under wet bark first.

lines.zh: 你壳上的纹路比我密
lines.en: Your shell has more rings than mine.

lines.zh: 别急，让我先闻闻触角
lines.en: Easy. Let me smell your antennae first.

lines.zh: 我们的幼崽小得像米粒
lines.en: Our young will be as small as rice grains.

lines.zh: 一起搬叶子铺窝，快些
lines.en: We'll carry leaves for the nest together.

lines.zh: 石头缝里够宽敞，就那儿
lines.en: The crack in the stone is roomy. There.

lines.zh: 我背上的箱子得先卸下来
lines.en: I should take the chest off my back first.

lines.zh: 以后这片苔藓我们分着吃
lines.en: We'll share this moss from now on.

lines.zh: 别滚太远，我追不上
lines.en: Don't roll too far. I can't keep up.

lines.zh: 这箱子大小正合我的背
lines.en: This chest fits my back perfectly.

lines.zh: 装上箱子，我慢了一半
lines.en: With the chest on, I'm half as fast.

lines.zh: 你放进去的东西，我都记得
lines.en: I remember everything you put inside.

lines.zh: 别装石头，实在太重
lines.en: No stones. Far too heavy.

lines.zh: 箱子盖没扣好，会掉出来
lines.en: The lid isn't latched. Things will spill.

lines.zh: 我背得动，但上坡费劲
lines.en: I can carry it. Hills are the problem.

lines.zh: 这箱子有股新木头的味道
lines.en: This chest smells of fresh wood.

lines.zh: 装满了，再塞就关不上
lines.en: Full. One more thing and it won't close.

lines.zh: 卸下来时轻得像换了个人
lines.en: Unloaded, I feel like a new bug.

lines.zh: 我给你背着，走哪儿都行
lines.en: I'll haul it for you, anywhere.

lines.zh: 有东西过来了，我先缩起来
lines.en: Something's coming. I curl up first.

lines.zh: 那影子太大，不像是朋友
lines.en: That shadow's too big to be friendly.

lines.zh: 我壳硬，咬不动我
lines.en: My shell is hard. Can't bite through it.

lines.zh: 它要真动手，我就装死
lines.en: If it really attacks, I play dead.

lines.zh: 你别走开，我一个人挡不住
lines.en: Don't leave. I can't hold it alone.

lines.zh: 我闻到它的口气了，很冲
lines.en: I smell its breath. Sharp and sour.

lines.zh: 我往石头底下退，那里窄
lines.en: I back under the stone. Too narrow for it.

lines.zh: 它踩了我一脚，壳没破
lines.en: It stepped on me. The shell held.

lines.zh: 我滚到它脚边，它跳开了
lines.en: I rolled at its feet. It jumped back.

lines.zh: 这东西不吃虫子，是冲你来的
lines.en: It's not after bugs. It wants you.

lines.zh: 我从壳缝里看它
lines.en: I watch it through the gap in my shell.

lines.zh: 它绕圈，我跟着转
lines.en: It circles. I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，但还是撑着
lines.en: My legs shake. I hold anyway.

lines.zh: 等它靠近，我就合上壳
lines.en: When it gets close, I snap shut.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁，是拿剑的
lines.en: I smell iron. It carries a sword.

lines.zh: 它踩下来，我就往旁边滚
lines.en: If it stomps, I roll aside.

lines.zh: 我不敢眨眼，虽然没眼皮
lines.en: I dare not blink, eyelid or not.

lines.zh: 它犹豫了，说明也怕
lines.en: It hesitates. So it's afraid too.

lines.zh: 我专看它的落脚处
lines.en: I keep my eyes on where it steps.

lines.zh: 只要它退一步，我就不动
lines.en: If it backs off one step, I stay still.

lines.zh: 我用壳撞它的脚趾
lines.en: I ram its toe with my shell.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，但很硌
lines.en: That won't hurt, but it will sting.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的脚毛，死不松
lines.en: I bite its foot fur and hold on.

lines.zh: 我的力气小，只能拖时间
lines.en: I'm weak. I can only buy time.

lines.zh: 滚过去撞它脚踝，就这一招
lines.en: Roll into its ankle. That's my one move.

lines.zh: 它把我踢飞了，壳还完整
lines.en: It kicked me away. Shell intact.

lines.zh: 我腿多，扒住就不容易甩掉
lines.en: Many legs. Hard to shake me off.

lines.zh: 打完缩成球，等它离开
lines.en: Afterward I curl up and wait it out.

lines.zh: 别站我后面，我滚起来没方向
lines.en: Don't stand behind me. I roll blind.

lines.zh: 我尽力了，剩下的交给你
lines.en: I did what I could. The rest is yours.

lines.zh: 从腐叶堆里钻出来，一身潮气
lines.en: I crawl out of the leaf litter, damp all over.

lines.zh: 石头底下太挤，我换一块
lines.en: Too crowded under that stone. Next one.

lines.zh: 我的壳还是软的，得躲几天
lines.en: My shell is still soft. I'll hide a few days.

lines.zh: 这片苔藓没人占，归我了
lines.en: Unclaimed moss. Mine now.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找蘑菇
lines.en: First order of business: find mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，满背是泥
lines.en: I push up through soil, mud all over my back.

lines.zh: 附近有只蚂蚁在搬东西
lines.en: An ant nearby is hauling something.

lines.zh: 天要下雨，正好我喜欢
lines.en: Rain's coming. Good. I like rain.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬，先熟悉这条路
lines.en: I crawl slowly, learning this path.

lines.zh: 头顶的树太密，光进不来
lines.en: The canopy is too thick. No light gets in.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，像块石头
lines.en: My shell heats up like a stone.

lines.zh: 从石头上滚下去，磕出白印
lines.en: Rolled off the stone. A white scrape appeared.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝里了
lines.en: Water seeps into the gaps of my shell.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀出去老远
lines.en: The blast threw me far.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我旁边的土里
lines.en: An arrow stuck in the dirt beside me.

lines.zh: 有种麻痒钻进我的甲片
lines.en: A tingling crawls between my plates.

lines.zh: 蘑菇吃光了，壳都变轻
lines.en: Mushrooms gone. My shell feels lighter.

lines.zh: 雷劈在石头上，我弹了起来
lines.en: Lightning hit the stone. I bounced.

lines.zh: 底下空空的，我一直在掉
lines.en: Empty below. I keep falling.
